summary: cloudflared là client tunnel của Cloudflare, cho phép tạo kết nối an toàn từ thiết bị local đến mạng Cloudflare Zero Trust, thay thế VPN truyền thống.
usecases: Expose local development server to internet securely for testing
Connect on-premise databases/services to Cloudflare Zero Trust network
Bypass NAT/firewalls for remote access without opening ports
ideas: Combine with Tailscale/DNS-over-HTTPS to create a global secure private network
Use as infrastructure for edge functions accessing internal resources
Automate tunnel setup for microservice deployment on private servers
